lower_scope_gate_evidence.summary: ECDC country-month data support descriptive growth proxies only; formal Rt remains blocked.

current_blockers: No disease-specific serial/generation-interval protocol is present.
No method justification ties formal Rt assumptions to monthly reported-count timing semantics.
CDC WONDER data are annual rather than subannual.
required_external_acquisitions: Acquire a disease-specific serial-interval or generation-interval citation package and protocol applicable to the exact hantavirus syndrome under analysis.
Acquire a subannual incidence time series with clear timing semantics suitable for Rt estimation, plus source provenance and case-definition documentation.
Acquire a reporting-delay/right-truncation protocol matched to that incidence source, with sensitivity-analysis plan.
checklist.pass_condition_summary: Formal Rt can pass only after a disease-specific interval protocol and a compatible subannual incidence series are both acquired and justified.

lower_scope_gate_evidence.summary: Descriptive country-month join QC and alias harmonization are documented; inferential join remains blocked.

current_blockers: Current sources mix ECDC country-month rows with CDC annual-state rows and cannot support a single inferential frame.
Environmental covariates exist only as a 1000-row GBIF-linked pilot subset, not a full aligned layer.
No approved non-causal target/outcome or spillover-safe inferential design exists.
required_external_acquisitions: Acquire approved left/right source tables sharing the same spatial and temporal unit for the intended inferential observation frame.
Acquire a full environmental covariate layer aligned to those joined units, with complete provenance and coverage metadata.
Acquire a pre-specified inferential target/outcome definition and protocol covering join keys, temporal windows, duplication handling, missingness policy, and bias controls.
checklist.pass_condition_summary: Inferential surveillance/spillover join can pass only after matched source tables, full aligned covariates, and an approved join target/bias-control design are acquired.

lower_scope_gate_evidence.summary: A pilot presence-background environment table exists for model-readiness QC only; no formal suitability/risk gate has passed.

current_blockers: Current environmental table is a pilot sample, not the final full covariate package.
Background design is simple global pilot background, not an approved accessible-area design.
No approved formal target definition exists for either suitability-only or risk analysis.
required_external_acquisitions: Acquire full DVC-tracked environmental covariate files or rasters with file-level metadata covering CRS, resolution, version, temporal coverage, and license/terms.
Acquire an approved target definition: either a suitability-only target with accessible-area/background design or a validated human/animal risk outcome table.
Acquire the final spatial validation and sampling-bias protocol for the full analysis frame, including block definition and background sensitivity plan.
checklist.pass_condition_summary: Formal environmental suitability/risk can pass only after full covariates, an approved target/background definition, and final bias-aware validation design are acquired.

lower_scope_gate_evidence.summary: Within-study capture/detection diagnostics are supported; global or cross-study abundance inference remains blocked.

current_blockers: Existing screened trapping sources support local diagnostics only, not cross-study abundance inference.
Cross-study effort, count, location, and survey design harmonization are not yet acquired.
No approved global/cross-study abundance model scope exists.
required_external_acquisitions: Acquire multi-study trapping datasets with explicit trap effort or trap-night fields, count/capture outcomes, locations or admin areas, dates, and usable license/terms metadata.
Acquire cross-study taxonomy/species standardization and duplicate-event review inputs, plus location-disclosure policy for retained studies.
Acquire an approved abundance/detection modeling protocol specifying how effort heterogeneity and survey-design differences will be handled across studies.
checklist.pass_condition_summary: Global/cross-study host abundance can pass only after multi-study effort-bearing trapping data and a cross-study abundance model protocol are acquired.

lower_scope_gate_evidence.summary: A minimal single-host Hantaan sequence set supports alignment-design evidence acquisition only; host-switch inference remains blocked.

current_blockers: Current sequence set comes from one host species in a narrow geographic context.
Host labels remain submitter-provided and need taxonomy/provenance audit.
No approved phylogenetic uncertainty and host-transition design exists for inference.
required_external_acquisitions: Acquire DVC-tracked sequence bodies and flatfile metadata spanning multiple host taxa and broader geographic diversity rather than the current single-host subset.
Acquire taxonomy-audit inputs for host labels and isolate provenance, plus duplicate, lab-strain, and reassortment screening artifacts.
Acquire a prespecified segment-specific alignment/tree workflow with uncertainty propagation suitable for host-trait transition inference.
checklist.pass_condition_summary: Host-switch phylogeny can pass only after multi-host sequence-body acquisition, taxonomy/provenance audit, and an approved segment-specific phylogenetic design are acquired.

guardrails: Do not mark advanced_model_gate_passed true from this checklist.
Lower-scope passes remain bounded to descriptive or readiness-only evidence.
Planning completeness is not scientific gate passage.
